message:DataSet.FULL_DESCRIPTION: The Production Indexes dataset presents data on industrial production, mining and quarrying, manufacturing, electricity, gas and water supply, construction, and retail sales indexes. These statistics are collected from national authorities, and when possible, from international organizations -via data-sharing agreements- that collect similar information to reduce the reporting burden on countries.
